newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Italy budget efforts good base for growth - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget efforts good base for growth - Ciampi.

text.p: Italy wants to combine efforts to tighten its public finances with economic development and job creation, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday.

"The significant results reached in terms of convergence constitute a solid base to allow the Italian economy to develop at rates closer to its potential and to create more jobs," said Ciampi, speaking at a meeting of the European Investment Bank.

"For this reason the current government intends to fulfil its task with an economic programme which combines ordering public finances with economic development and the creation of new jobs in a better way," he said.

Ciampi said stability, a single currency, completion of a single market and recovery in investment were the "greatest contribution of the European Union to the struggle against unemployment, the main social and economic challenge which Europe is called on to face."
Ciampi repeated Italy's goal of reaching the three percent budget deficit to gross domestic product ratio needed this year to take part in a single European currency.

"The process of re-ordering public finances has been of remarkable dimensions and the results achieved in terms of reduction in interest rates and keeping price growth under control underlines the effectiveness of this process," he added.
